title: Prawn tacos with lime slaw
steps: Finely shred the red cabbage and mix with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt.
Season the prawns with paprika, chilli flakes, garlic and salt and fry in the oil for 2–3 minutes until pink.
Stir the yoghurt with a little lime juice and slice the avocado.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, fill with cabbage, prawns, avocado and yoghurt and sprinkle with coriander.
